To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the dimeric Cu,Zn super-oxide dismutase was crystallized and the crystal structure was solved at 1.8 A resolution.
we have overexpressed and purified recombinant dSOD, and have crystallized it in space group P3 (2) 21 with four Cu,Zn dimeric molecules in the asymmetric unit.
a cDNA encoding dSOD has been cloned and sequenced and that the recombinant enzyme has been overexpressed, purified, crystallized and its crystallographic data collected.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the cloning, expression, purification and crystallization of Peking duck Cu, Zn SOD.
the cloning, expression, crystallization and X-ray diffraction studies of dSOD.
the structural characterization of dSOD and the investigation of its biological and physiological functions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the crystal structure of dSOD is very similar to that of the other SODs.
the structure determination of the dimeric Cu,Zn SOD from Peking duck is in progress.
dSOD crystals belong to space groups P3(1)21 and P3(2), with a = 124 A, c = 162 A, and a = 125 A, c =163 A, respectively.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have cloned the cDNA encoding Cu,Zn super-oxide dismutase in the duck, and that the enzyme was overexpresssed in Escherichi coli, purified and crystallized.
the Peking duck Cu, Zn superoxide dismutases are the most promising candidates to study the evolution of Cu, Zn super-oxide dismutases.
we have successfully cloned, overexpressed and purified dSOD to homogeneity, and have also obtained its initial crystals.
The main takeaway from our work is that
dSOD has a unique structure that is different from the known structures of Cu,Zn SOD from other species.
dSOD is a potential target to control oxidative stress in the duck.
the dimeric structure of Cu,Zn SOD is conserved among all vertebrate SODs, including the Peking duck, which has a unique double-helix crystal packing.
